arg.name: robot_model
arg.description: Model of the robot to use

arg.name: configuration_package
arg.description: The ROS package where we find the configuration files.

arg.name: semantic_description_file_path
arg.description: URDF/XACRO semantic description file with the robot.

arg.name: prefix
arg.description: Prefix of the joint names, useful for multi-robot setup.

arg.name: start_rviz
arg.description: Launch RViz visualization with MoveIt2 config?

arg.name: rviz_file_path
arg.description: Rviz2 configuration file of the visualization.

arg.name: move_group_config_file_path
arg.description: YAML file with the move_group configuration.

arg.name: ompl_planning_file_path
arg.description: YAML file with the OMPL planning configuration.

arg.name: pilz_planning_file_path
arg.description: YAML file with the Pilz planning configuration.

arg.name: pilz_cartesian_limits_file_path
arg.description: YAML file with the Pilz cartesian limits configuration.

arg.name: joint_limits_file_path
arg.description: YAML file with the joint limits configuration.

arg.name: moveit_controllers_file_path
arg.description: YAML file with the MoveIt controllers configuration.

arg.name: kinematics_file_path
arg.description: YAML file with the kinematics configuration.

let.name: robot_description_semantic_content
let.value: $(command '$(find-exec xacro) $(var semantic_description_file_path) prefix:=$(var prefix) robot_model:=$(var robot_model)')
